message:
At sigma 0.9874, the velocity changed sharply from the prior prediction (relative RMS 1.079, cosine 0.688), while the latent moved only slightly. That supports keeping the schedule dense at this early point. The completed-image feedback has no candidate results to compare.

I inspected the paused state and kept `analysis.py` and `updater.py` unchanged. The existing rule should follow the reference schedule here and only skip a point later if consecutive predictions are exceptionally similar.

**Prediction:** It will make no early skips and may rarely skip at mid-range sigma. Lower matched-prompt HPS/CLIP scores, or evidence that it skips despite unstable predictions, would argue against the rule. No candidate quality results are available yet.
